# Signal Generation

Produces buy/sell signals from market data using ML models (XGBoost/Platt calibration). Ingests OHLCV feeds, computes features, and outputs probability-scored trade signals.

# Position Manager

Receives scored signals and decides position sizing, risk limits, and portfolio allocation. Enforces stop-loss, take-profit, and maximum exposure constraints before forwarding orders.

# Execution Engine

Executes validated orders against the exchange API. Handles order routing, fill tracking, slippage management, and real-time execution reporting back to the pipeline.
